title: Phagistry – The German Registry for Clinical Bacteriophage Therapy
summary: With rising rates of antimicrobial resistance, interest in the therapeutic potential of bacteriophage therapy has been renewed. However, due to regulatory restrictions and logistical challenges, phage therapy is, in many countries, only available on a case-by-case basis. To address the resulting lack of systematic data and to gain further insight into its safety and efficacy, this study aims to implement a national registry documenting cases of phage therapy in Germany. The study is designed as a multicentre, observational registry incorporating both prospective and retrospective data collection.
conditions: Patients treated with bacteriophages alone or a combination of bacteriophages with other anti-infectives (e.g. antibiotics, antiseptic solutions) or a combination of bacteriophages with other therapeutic interventions (e.g. surgical intervention, probiotics etc.).

interventions.name: Multi-centre, observational, prospective, and retrospective registry. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients with planned, ongoing, or completed bacteriophage therapy will be included. For prospective pseudonymised data collection, written informed consent must be obtained prior to enrollment.
Exclusion criteria:
Patient with any personal or logistical condition which in the opinion of the investigator may interfere with the informed consent process (only applicable in case of prospective pseudonymised inclusion).
